assertion.statement: The multiplier prescription (4.4a) defines an automorphism of the actual finite extension L_infinity/F_infinity once every multiplicative relation has the stated trivial multiplier.
assertion.objects: F_infinity=K(mu_(2^infinity)), the finitely many alpha_a and their 2^n-th roots.
assertion.hypotheses: The actual imaginary quadratic K and relation-basis radicands are fixed; F_infinity contains the required roots of unity. The preceding odd-prime valuation calculation proves compatibility with every relation, including unit relations.
assertion.quantifiers: Each finite n and each actual finite relation-basis family.
assertion.parameter_range: Finite radical extension over the possibly infinite cyclotomic field.
assertion.constants: Exact root-of-unity multipliers, with no scalar division.
assertion.normalizations: The sign in (4.4a) matches the later connecting-map convention.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Dyadic weights are zero. Descent to a finite layer and the later Chebotarev application are separate steps.
assertion.limit_order: Check all relations by valuations, obtain a character on B, and then realize it as a radical automorphism.

use.reason: Supplies the radical automorphism after the actual all-relation valuation check.

supplier.statement: The finite radical pairing Gal(F(B^(1/n))/F) x B -> mu_n is perfect under the stated root-of-unity and characteristic hypotheses.

available_assertion.statement: The finite radical pairing Gal(F(B^(1/n))/F) x B -> mu_n is perfect under the stated root-of-unity and characteristic hypotheses.
available_assertion.objects: An arbitrary field F, the group of n-th roots of unity, and finite subgroups B of F*/F*^n.
available_assertion.hypotheses: F contains a primitive n-th root of unity and its characteristic does not divide n.
available_assertion.quantifiers: Every such F,n and finite subgroup B.
available_assertion.parameter_range: Positive integer n; no number-field hypothesis on F.
available_assertion.normalizations: Roots are chosen in a fixed algebraic closure; B consists of classes modulo n-th powers.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: No independence of a chosen list of radicands is assumed. This does not assert a Chebotarev theorem over an infinite base.
available_assertion.limit_order: Fix F,n and B before forming the finite radical extension.
